cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Can Handle This
cards.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm fully prepared to open this rejection email. Put the water on a coaster, please. Why the whole jug?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Small sips helped when I lost my job. I kept needing more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Leave it within reach, not over there. Small sips, properly spaced. That's how I'm approaching this.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My sister read mine aloud. Shall I read yours?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Start with the greeting, please. Don't jump to the decision. I'll take the next sip after each sentence; you keep reading.

reason: Show A borrowing each offered coping strategy while correcting its execution, without a final sentence explaining that it proves A's system.
